statement: Migrate persisted memory records by changing only schema version and revision.
rationale: Memory records are durable attributed reasoning. Moving them to the shared v2 label is a serialization migration, not permission to rewrite statements, rationale, origin, references, assumptions or source pins. The one-time script verifies the old revision before writing and recomputes the new revision.
assumptions: The migration changes no user or agent reasoning and Git history retains the old revisions.
